            - button "Search"

            - button "Runs"

        - tree "Resources":
          - treeitem "Release workspace Actions for Release workspace" [expanded] [level=1]:

          - treeitem "Checkout audit Actions for Checkout audit" [level=2] [selected]:

            - button "Actions for Checkout audit"

          - treeitem "Research sources Actions for Research sources" [level=2]:
            - text: Research sources
            - button "Actions for Research sources"
          - treeitem "Design system Actions for Design system" [expanded] [level=1]:
            - text: Design system
            - button "Actions for Design system"
          - treeitem "Motion tokens Actions for Motion tokens" [level=2]:
            - text: Motion tokens
            - button "Actions for Motion tokens"
          - treeitem "Component inventory Actions for Component inventory" [level=2]:
            - text: Component inventory
            - button "Actions for Component inventory"
          - treeitem "Archived runs Actions for Archived runs" [level=1]:
            - text: Archived runs
            - button "Actions for Archived runs"
        - button "Toggle sidebar"
      - main:
        - button "Toggle sidebar" [expanded]
        - paragraph: Checkout release
        - paragraph: Agent workspace · focused patch
        - text: Connected
        - navigation "Message navigation":
          - button "Go to user message 1 of 3"
          - button "Go to assistant message 2 of 3"
          - button "Go to assistant message 3 of 3"
        - region "Conversation":
          - log:
            - article "user message": You 10:24 Audit the checkout flow, fix the validation gap, and prepare a release-ready patch.
            - article "assistant message":
              - text: beUI Agent 10:24
              - button "Completed 3 steps" [expanded]
              - region "Completed 3 steps":
                - list:
                  - listitem: Tracing the checkout submission path and validation boundary.
                  - listitem: Read checkout/submit.ts
                  - listitem:
                    - text: order validation failures
                    - link "Agent interface guide beui.dev":
                      - /url: /docs/ai-agents
              - region "Agent task list":
                - button "Release plan 2 of 4 tasks completed" [expanded]:
                  - heading "Release plan" [level=3]
                  - text: 2 of 4 tasks completed
                - region "Release plan 2 of 4 tasks completed":
                  - list:
                    - listitem: "Completed: Inspect the checkout flow"
                    - listitem: "Completed: Prepare the validation patch"
                    - listitem: "Pending: Run focused checks"
                    - listitem: "Pending: Collect release approval"
            - article "assistant message":
              - text: Run focused checkout checks? terminal.run Approval required
              - paragraph: The agent needs permission to run the validation and accessibility suites.
              - button "View details" [expanded]
              - term: Command
              - definition:
                - code: bun test checkout --coverage
              - term: Scope
              - definition: Current workspace
              - button "Allow once"
              - button "Always allow"
              - button "Deny"
        - textbox "Prompt":
          - /placeholder: Ask the agent to continue…
        - button "Add to prompt"
        - button "Balanced"
        - button "Send prompt" [disabled]
